name: auryn-orm
summary: Language-agnostic ORM model<->database-table stitch for Auryn: a post-ingestion hook that joins a SQLAlchemy model class (in a code graph) to the physical Table/Column nodes a SQL ingestor produced (in a schema graph), by table/column name. Forms the code->database connection across two ingestors so a query can trace a function -> its ORM model -> the real table. Depends only on auryn-core.
